verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jacob yet' masanil heb' yiko' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba, ix snhusan silab' winh t'a sDiosal, haton sDiosal winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix lolon Dios t'a winh t'a swayich, ix awtaj winh yuj: --Jacob, xchi. Ix tak'wi winh: --Oy, ina wajek' tik Mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in ton a Diosal in yet' winh a mam, manh ach xiw a b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Yakb'an ayex ek' ta' ol in b'o jun niwan chonhab' t'a inhtilal.

Ol in b'atnhej et'ok t'a Egipto chi', haxo yik ol k'och stiempoal, ol in ochnhej yet' heb' inhtilal ayik ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a jun lugar tik. Axo yik ol ach chamok, a winh uninal aj José chi', ayek' winh t'a a tz'ey, xchi Dios t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jik'e winh yuj heb' winh yuninal t'a yol karreta ix yak'kot winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix yak'anpaxk'e heb' unin yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix el heb' winh t'a Beerseba chi'.
Ix kot heb' winh t'a Egipto, ix yik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' winh yet' nok' swakax yet' masanil tastak ix yik' heb' winh t'a Canaán chi'.
Ix yik'ankot masanil heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' ix yisil yet' heb' yixchikin.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh yet' ix Lea ix kot yet'ok t'a Egipto, 33 heb' t'a smasanil, ayoch heb' winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'isulok. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Rubén, haton winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón yet' ix Dina. Ha heb' tik ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Padán-aram. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Rubén: Haton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Simeón: Haton winhaj Jemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Ohad, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zohar yet' winhaj Saúl, winh yune' jun ix aj Canaán. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Koat yet' winhaj Merari. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Haton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán, winhaj Sela, winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zara. (Ha winhaj Er yet' winhaj Onán chi', chamnakxo heb' winh t'a Canaán). Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Fares chi', haton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Isacar: Haton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Job yet' winhaj Simrón. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Zabulón: Haton winhaj Sered, winhaj Elón yet' winhaj Jahleel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Zilpa, 16 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha ix Zilpa chi', haton ix skriada ix Lea ix ak'ji yuj winh sman, haton winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Gad: Haton winhaj Zifión, winhaj Hagui, winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Suni, winhaj Eri, winhaj Arodi yet' winhaj Areli. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aser: Haton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix yanab' heb' winh skuchan Sera. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Bería chi', haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malkiel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Raquel, 14 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix: Haton winhaj José yet' winhaj Benjamín. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj José chi' yet' ix Asenat yisil winhaj Potifera sakerdote t'a chonhab' On: Haton winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Efraín, haton heb' ix alji t'a Egipto. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Benjamín chi': Haton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Gera, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ehi, winhaj Ros, winhaj Mupim, winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Ard.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix Bilha, ukwanh heb'. Ha ix Bilha chi', haton ix skriada ix Raquel ix ak'ji yuj winhaj Labán. Ha heb' yuninal winh yet' ix, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Dan yet' winhaj Neftalí. Ha yuninal winhaj Dan chi', anhej winhaj Husim. Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Neftalí chi': Haton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Silem.
66 heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' t'a smasanil, haton heb' tik ajun yet' winh ayik ix k'och winh t'a Egipto. Haton wal heb' tik yinhtilal winh, ch'ok pax heb' ix alib'al.
Ch'ok pax yaj winhaj José yet' chawanh heb' yuninal ix alji t'a Egipto chi', yuj chi' 70 sb'isul winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal ayik ayxoek' winh ta'.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at winhaj Judá yuj winhaj Jacob chi', yik sb'at winh yal yab' winhaj José chi' to skot winh chawal t'a yol yik Gosén. Axo yik ix k'och heb' t'a Gosén chi',

ix schekan winhaj José chi' ak'chaj lista skarruaje yik b'at schaan winh smam winh t'a Gosén chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh. Te junip ix em nhojan winh yok' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh smam chi'.
Axo ix yalan winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, tik wal ix wilxioch a sat, tik wal pitzan achto, junk'olalxo ol in cham tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuk'tak yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh smam winh chi': --Tik tzin b'at wal t'a winh rey: Masanil heb' winh wuk'tak yet' masanil heb' yinhtilal winh in mam ay t'a Canaán, toxo ix ja heb' wet'ok.
Yet'nak masanil nok' skalnel heb', nok' swakax yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', yujto a smunlajel heb' haton moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax, xin chama.
Yuj chi', ayik ol ex awtajb'at yuj winh rey chi', ol sk'anb'an winh t'ayex tas b'aj tzex munlaji,

tzeyalani to moloj kalnel yet' moloj wakax tze k'ulej. Anhej nok' kalnel ko molb'etz yaji yiktax onh kotoch uninal icha wal heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi. Yuj chi' ol ex kan t'a lum Gosén tik, yujto a heb' winh aj Egipto tik ay yowalil tato junnhej tz'aj heb' winh yet' heb' winh molum kalnel, xchi winhaj José chi'.
